date_note: Al Jazeera's 24 November article says the incident began on a Sunday (22 November); the page gives no clock time.
title: Israel Police shut down internal systems over information security concerns, media report
summary: Al Jazeera, citing an Israeli TV channel and Yedioth Ahronoth, reports that Israel Police shut down several internal systems and applications over information security concerns. Yedioth Ahronoth said this included the Mesaront messaging system, and officers were told to use other means of communication. Al Jazeera says the cause is unknown, investigators are checking whether it was a cyberattack or an external technical fault, and it is unclear whether any data leaked.
plain: Israeli media say the police shut down internal systems over security worries. The cause is not known, and it is unclear whether any secret information leaked.
exec: Per Al Jazeera, citing Israeli media, police lost internal systems used to pass instructions to officers; the cause is unknown and no breach is confirmed.

validation.note: One publisher read (Al Jazeera, relaying Channel 14 and Yedioth Ahronoth); the Israel Police has no statement among pages read.
